name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
summary: A bounty notice declares that Overseer Maltorius, a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent and newly hired commander of the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew of the Cauldron, is to die. By order of Overseer Oilfist, his head must be brought back as proof to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker.

sections.title: A Price on a Traitor
sections.body: Overseer Maltorius, a traitorous Dark Iron dwarf, is to be found in the depths of the Cauldron's Slag Pit. The order is to slay him, take his head, and carry it back to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker for the bounty.

faq.answer: A traitorous Dark Iron dwarf. The notice calls him a rogue Thorium Brotherhood agent and the newly hired commander of the Dark Iron Slag Pit crew of the Cauldron.

faq.q: Where can Overseer Maltorius be found?
faq.answer: Down in the Slag Pit, which belongs to the Cauldron.

faq.q: Who ordered the death of Overseer Maltorius?
faq.answer: Overseer Oilfist, who is named in the notice as having given the order.

faq.q: Who receives proof of Maltorius's death?
aliases: who to turn in maltorius head
faq.answer: Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker, in Searing Gorge. The head of Maltorius is the proof asked for.
